citeAs: Gokaslan, A., Cooper, A. F., Collins, J., Seguin, L., Jacobson, A., Patel, M., Frankle, J., Stephenson, C., & Kuleshov, V. (2023). CommonCanvas: An Open Diffusion Model Trained with Creative-Commons Images. arXiv preprint arXiv:2310.16825.
creator: Aaron Gokaslan, A. Feder Cooper, Jasmine Collins, Landan Seguin, Austin Jacobson, Mihir Patel, Jonathan Frankle, Cory Stephenson, Volodymyr Kuleshov (Cornell Tech, Databricks Mosaic)
description: A dataset of roughly 70 million Creative-Commons-licensed images paired with high-quality synthetic captions generated using BLIP-2.
name: CommonCatalog
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Images were center-cropped and resized to a maximum size of 512x512 pixels, then captioned using the pre-trained BLIP-2 OPT2.5B model.
rai:dataCollection: Images were re-scraped from Flickr based on IDs provided in the YFCC100M metadata, excluding images with non-derivative (ND) licenses.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: The YFCC100M dataset, which consists of 100 million CC-licensed images and multimedia files, as well as Flickr IDs linking to the original data.
rai:dataLimitations: The dataset underperformed in several categories, including faces, general photography, and paintings.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset provides an alternative to web-scraped datasets with unclear provenance, navigating copyright concerns by using only open-licensed Creative-Commons images.

null_reasons.rai:annotatorDemographics: Captions are synthetically generated by a machine model.

null_reasons.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: No post-preprocessing manipulations described for the dataset itself.
